Requirements.SystemGoal: Event-driven Smart Home Automation System: sensors publish events through EventBus, actuators subscribe and react, controller coordinates scenarios. System runs in-process, no external services, verified by deterministic tests.

UseCase.Name: Event publish / subscribe
UseCase.Description: EventBus accepts events from publishers and delivers to all registered subscribers.

UseCase.Name: Smart home orchestration
UseCase.Description: SmartHomeController creates EventBus, registers all sensors and actuators.

UseCase.Name: CLI entrypoint with JSON output
UseCase.Description: main.py runs SmartHomeController, executes scenarios, outputs JSON.

UseCase.Name: Deterministic verification
UseCase.Description: pytest covers each use case. All tests deterministic, no external deps.

InScope.Item: Event dataclass and Device base model
Thermostat as subscriber on temperature events
LightBulb as subscriber on motion events
pytest tests for all use cases

BusinessInvariants.Invariant: Every published event is delivered to all subscribers exactly once.
Thermostat.is_on == True iff last temperature < threshold.
LightBulb.is_on == True iff last motion == True.
EventBus does not lose subscribers during publish.
SmartHomeController does not modify EventBus directly.
Event is immutable. Payload does not mutate after publish.

Failure.Behavior: EventBus logs error, continues delivery to other subscribers.

Failure.Trigger: Publish to topic with no subscribers.

Failure.Behavior: ImportError with clear message. Exit code 1.

Defect.Description: Synchronous delivery blocks on slow subscriber.

SuccessCriteria.Criterion: All 6 use cases covered by pytest tests.
Integration scenario passes end-to-end through EventBus.
main.py outputs valid JSON with device state.
